generations.prompt: Photoreal, mid-morning inside a city tram, 35 mm. The silver-haired woman in the mustard-yellow raincoat draws in the sketchbook on her knee as the tram sways gently and daylight slides across the windows; she looks across the aisle at the two young passengers, then back to the page. The young man and the young woman across the aisle talk to each other in a quiet, natural, continuous conversation, turned toward each other. Sound: their conversation, clearly audible, with the hum and rattle of the tram and a soft bell at a stop; no music. The camera is locked off and does not move. She does not speak. Exactly the people already in the frame; nobody new enters. No on-screen text, no captions, no lettering anywhere.
